dedupe_keys.name: sisteme de coordonate de referinta statii gnns

description: Sisteme de coordonate de referință - stații GNNS is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.ancpi.ro. Dataset with GNSS ROMPOS standing stations. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Coordinate reference systems - GNNS stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
